promotion_enabled.description: Global switch to enable or disable self-promotion campaigns across mobile apps

ai_enabled.description: Global switch for mobile AI features

ads_enabled.description: Global switch for third-party advertising SDKs

min_app_version.description: Minimum supported app version. Versions below this will display update prompts.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Default promotion client cache TTL (in seconds, 21600 = 6 hours)

request_timeout_ms.description: Network timeout limit for mobile background refresh (in milliseconds)

emergency_ai_kill_switch.description: Emergency switch to instantly disable all AI endpoints and route mobile apps to safe defaults

Mobile Runtime Flags.description: Lightweight runtime flags consumed by mobile apps for non-blocking startup and fallback
